name: Uttar Pradesh planned data center park - Kanpur (state plan)
developer: Government of Uttar Pradesh / investors TBD
notes: Kanpur is one of eight cities selected for UP data centre parks (Noida, Greater Noida, Yamuna Expressway, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Agra); ETDatacenters (Apr 2026) reported site identification and master-plan preparation for Kanpur, Varanasi and Agra were still in progress. State target cited at 900 MW (2021 policy) and 2 GW by 2030 (2026 policy), but no Kanpur-specific capacity or named investor/site as of Aug 2026. No physical facility confirmed in Kanpur district.

name: CtrlS Lucknow Edge Datacenter (Gomti Nagar)
notes: CtrlS official page lists a carrier-neutral edge datacenter in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow: 49 racks capacity, 0.20 MW IT load (datacentermap lists 0.18 MW), 2,500 sq ft on a partial floor. Operational colocation facility serving enterprise and hyperscale customers.

name: Sify Lucknow Edge Data Center
notes: Sify chairman Raju Vegesna stated on the Q1 FY2026-27 earnings call (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026) that Sify has completed edge data centers in Lucknow and Chandigarh and is constructing two more, targeting 2-3 edge DCs per year in tier-2/3 cities; ET reported the same February 2025 plan with ~10 MW small-capacity 'AI factory' sites in cities including Lucknow. Exact Lucknow capacity not published; facility operational as of mid-2026.

name: VueNow Edge Data Centre - Malihabad (Lucknow district)
notes: DCD (Dec 2024) reports VueNow inaugurated two new Edge data centers in Malihabad (a tehsil of Lucknow district) and Ambedkarnagar, led by the MoS for Excise & Prohibition with IT department officials; part of the 750-edge-DC network under the 2021 MoU. Capacity not disclosed; VueNow under ED investigation for the 'cloud particle' scam.

name: Uttar Pradesh State Data Centre (Lucknow)
notes: Official UP government portals (ODOP, UPDESCO-hosted sites) state their websites are hosted at the Uttar Pradesh State Data Centre, Lucknow; ET Government reports the UP State Data Centre hosts 250 services of 61 departments with a dedicated helpdesk at UPLC Lucknow. Government e-governance data centre, operational.

name: National Data Centre - Census of India (Disaster Recovery Site), Lucknow
developer: Census of India / Office of the Registrar General (Government of India)
notes: India's third National Data Centre, inaugurated 26 Feb 2021 at the UP State Census Directorate, Lucknow, as an upgraded data capture centre and disaster recovery site storing census data of all Indian states, with Delhi and Bengaluru NDCs as primary sites. Government-operated; no commercial capacity published.

name: Uttar Pradesh planned data center cluster / AI City - Lucknow
developer: Multiple prospective investors / Government of Uttar Pradesh (Tata Group dialogue)
notes: ETDatacenters (Jun 2026) reports UP has approved ~Rs 21,343 crore of data center investment proposals distributed across Noida, Yamuna Expressway Region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut and Sitapur with 644 MW committed capacity; CM Yogi (May 2026) directed officials to start dialogue with major companies including the Tata Group to develop Lucknow as an 'AI City'. No specific Lucknow site/developer capacity allocated yet.
